title: Record player
prompt: a record player: put on a record, drop the needle and it plays, lift the arm; see-through shows the motor, belt, platter bearing, tonearm pivot, cartridge and preamp
blurb: Lift a record off its sleeve onto the platter, start the belt-drive motor and lower the needle; as it plays the spiral groove pulls the arm inward, and see-through shows the motor, belt, bearing, tonearm pivot, cartridge and preamp.
